title: Deception and ITDR enrichment integrations: supported sources, credentials needed, and the event-log fields each adds

checks.do: Which product the enrichment answer is about, since the Deception Enrich page lists nine solutions and the ITDR Enrich page lists six.

Whether the admin portal has network connectivity to the vendor server and an account and API key, as the AbuseIPDB, GreyNoise Intelligence, Hybrid Analysis, IPinfo, Joe Sandbox and VirusTotal guides require.

enrich-supported-sources.statement: Enrichment integrations can be configured for AbuseIPDB, GreyNoise Intelligence, Hybrid Analysis, IPinfo, Joe Sandbox, Palo Alto Networks WildFire, Shadowserver, VirusTotal and Zscaler Sandbox (Deception Enrich page); the ITDR Enrich page lists Hybrid Analysis, Joe Sandbox, Palo Alto Networks WildFire, Shadowserver, VirusTotal and Zscaler Sandbox.

quotes: Configure enrichment integrations on the following supported solutions:
Configure enrichment integrations on the following supported solutions:

enrich-purpose.statement: Events can be enriched with contextual information from geolocation tools, third-party threat intelligence databases, sandbox analysis reports, etc.; the Deception page adds that enrichment helps reduce false positives.

quotes: events can be enriched with contextual information from geolocation tools, third-party threat intelligence databases, sandbox analysis reports, etc.
Reduce false positives, which allows you to manage security threats efficiently.

itdr-enrich-columns.statement: The ITDR Enrich page lists each integration with Enabled (whether the enrichment integration is enabled or not) and Settings (the name of the third-party security solution).

quotes: Enabled: Indicates if the enrichment integration is enabled or not.
Settings: The name of the third-party security solution.

enrich-api-key-sources.statement: The Deception AbuseIPDB, GreyNoise Intelligence, Hybrid Analysis, IPinfo, Joe Sandbox and VirusTotal guides each require network connectivity from the admin portal to the vendor, an account, and an API key (IPinfo: an API access token); the Joe Sandbox key is under User Settings > API Key in the Joe Sandbox console.

wildfire-enrichment.statement: The Palo Alto Networks WildFire enrichment needs an active WildFire account, the WildFire console URL and an API key (copied from My Account in the WildFire console); the configuration window takes the console URL and the API key, and the Deception page adds that Deception evidence files can be sent to the WildFire sandbox.

The Palo Alto Networks WildFire console URL.
In the Palo Alto Networks WildFire console, go to My Account and copy the API key.
Enter the URL of the Palo Alto Networks WildFire console.
You can send the Deception evidence files to the Palo Alto Networks WildFire sandbox to enrich incident investigations and response.
An active Palo Alto Networks WildFire account.

In the Palo Alto Networks WildFire console, go to My Account and copy the API key.

shadowserver-enrichment.statement: The Shadowserver enrichment is enabled by selecting Enabled in the Shadowserver window; its prerequisite is network connectivity from the admin portal to the Shadowserver server.

quotes: Ensure that there is network connectivity from the Deception Admin Portal to the Shadowserver server.
In the Shadowserver window, select Enabled.
Ensure that there is network connectivity from the ITDR Admin Portal to the Shadowserver server.
In the Shadowserver window, select Enabled.

abuseipdb-fields.statement: In the Deception guide, the additional fields AbuseIPDB enrichment creates in the event logs are prefixed with abuseip: abuseConfidenceScore, countryCode, countryName, ipAddress, ipVersion, isPublic, isWhitelisted, lastReportedAt and totalReports; the integration enriches events from internet-facing decoys.

quotes: Deception integration with AbuseIPDB helps you to enrich events from internet-facing decoys.
The additional fields created in the event logs are prefixed with abuseip:

greynoise-fields.statement: In the Deception guide, the additional fields GreyNoise Intelligence enrichment creates in the event logs are prefixed with greynoise: categories, category.activity, category.actor, category.hosting, category.scanner, category.search_engine, category.tool, category.worm, returned_count and status.

quotes: The additional fields created in the event logs are prefixed with greynoise:

virustotal-fields.statement: The additional fields VirusTotal enrichment creates in the event logs are prefixed with vt: positives, total, names, error and permalink.

quotes: The additional fields created in the event logs are prefixed with vt:
The additional fields created in the event logs are prefixed with vt:

shadowserver-fields.statement: The additional fields Shadowserver enrichment creates in the event logs are prefixed with binary: os_version, trusted_signature, os_name, sig_timestamp, description and fileversion.

quotes: The additional fields created in the event logs are prefixed with binary:
The additional fields created in the event logs are prefixed with binary:

ipinfo-field.statement: In the Deception guide, after IPinfo enrichment is enabled, the enriched IP geolocation data from IPinfo is available in the attacker.country field on the Event Logs page.

quotes: Deception integration with IPinfo enriches events with insights from the IP geolocation data.
the enriched IP geolocation data from IPinfo is available in the attacker.country field on the Event Logs page.

sandbox-test-procedure.statement: The Deception Hybrid Analysis, Joe Sandbox and Palo Alto Networks WildFire guides test the integration by running an application file on a network decoy with Windows service enabled; when an alert is generated on the Investigate dashboard the evidence file is sent to the sandbox, and the report can then be downloaded for analysis.

quotes: To test the integration, run an application file on a network decoy with Windows service enabled.
When an alert is generated on the Investigate dashboard, send the evidence file to the Hybrid Analysis sandbox.
After you send the evidence file to the sandbox, you can download the report for analysis.
